reconstruction.test_programs: Use the 38 test-list entries byte for byte at test_revision and append the FENCE.I test. The evaluator stages the local assembly for the shared harness.

comparison.architectural_traces: After excluding the fixed RTL boot prefix before the first Spike PC, compare each retired instruction, destination-register update, and width-masked architectural store update between CVA6 and Spike.
comparison.completion_requirement: Every CPU run and both comparisons must complete. The fixed tree builds and runs every program with the reference module, so after only the target is replaced a build failure, a missing target module, an RTL simulation that does not complete (including the fixed RVFI cycle limit and assertions) and a comparison mismatch are FAIL. Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID.
